## ITRateLimitOptions type

Rate-limit configuration for incoming updates (`@grammyjs/ratelimiter`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITRateLimitOptions = {
    windowMs: number;
    max: number;
};
```

## Remarks

Configuration only — the rate-limit key and the behavior when the limit is exceeded are provided by overriding the [Gramstax.hookKeyGenerator()](./gramstax.gramstax.hookkeygenerator.md) and [Gramstax.hookRateLimited()](./gramstax.gramstax.hookratelimited.md) class hooks.
